descriptionHtml: Replaces star and black hole sprites with compact icons. Improves map readability when large modded core worlds are present. Adjusts the enterable nebula sprite to blend better with surrounding map nebulas.
discordPostHtml:
Changes some of the icons and sprites from the Star map.

This mod changes the star and black hole sprites and its icons for a compact one, greatly improves map readability with large modded core worlds, it also changes the enterable nebula sprite to blend better with the map nebula around.
